msp-healthinstitution.note: Ministry of Health health-establishment posts (FR and AR are separate parallel posts), de-duplicated by post id exactly as fetchMSP() does, paged 100 at a time until a short page. Captured from an Algerian vantage point: sante.gov.dz drops TCP from outside Algeria, so this is the first committed capture of the registry and the only way the package can be rebuilt offline. The fetcher's --cache mode still reads research/sante/msp-healthinstitution-raw.json, which is gitignored; wiring it to this capture is a follow-up.

msp-wilaya-taxonomy.note: The categorie-healthinstitution taxonomy terms that carry each establishment post's wilaya. Same Algeria-only vantage point as msp-healthinstitution.
